description: Names the overlay preset a patch is built around, and passes it to the CHEM Extended Macro modules beside it so their macros are sent only while that preset is playing
notes: it does nothing until a preset is configured, which is done from the hamburger menu on the panel
with a preset configured, the chiclet button under the lamp loads it on the instrument, and the green lamp at the top lights while the playing preset matches the configured one
one of these belongs to one CHEM Core, and each Extended Macro module links to the Overlay on its left, or through a run of adjacent Extended Macro modules to a common one
the hamburger menu on the panel also sets a title for the module and the colours of the panel and the title text
extended macros are numbered 7 to 90 and exist only in overlay presets; the Eagan Matrix Overlay Developer's Guide, shipped with the Haken firmware, is what describes making them
menu: Use live preset — on the hamburger menu on the panel, not the right-click menu; makes the preset the instrument is playing the one this module tracks
